reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it announces a $25 Ulta Beauty gift-card winner in a subscriber giveaway selected through random comments. The contact request and 24-hour deadline are presented as instructions for the named winner to arrange receipt of the prize, not as an investment or purchase offer. Whether the gift card was delivered and what contact details were requested remain unverified.

citations.quote: WINNER of $25 ULTA BEAUTY Gift Card-100 Subscriber Giveaway
today's video is about the winner of my 100 plus subscriber giveaway
the recipient of this giveaway is actually going to receive a $25 Ulta gift card
it randomly picks the comments from that particular video and then it chooses a winner for you
you are the winner of the $25 Ulta gift card

opening.argument: The video ties a promised $25 gift card directly to a personal-information request and a short claim window. The stated winner is told to email contact information so the creator can discuss obtaining the card, while the description says the winner has only 24 hours to claim it. That is a reward-for-contact workflow, not merely an announcement: the viewer must disclose information before the promised asset can supposedly be arranged. The evidence does not establish what information is required, how it will be handled, or that the reward was ever delivered. Those unresolved conditions make the low-effort reward solicitation materially concerning.

citations.quote: I want you to email me your contact information and so we can chat about getting you your Alta gift card
YOU HAVE 24 HOURS TO CLAIM YOUR PRIZE
The winner will receive an ULTA BEAUTY gift card in the amount of $25.00

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this an ordinary giveaway does not remove the solicitation. The reference opening confirms both the promised gift card and the instruction to provide contact information, but those facts support the concern that a reward is conditioned on an off-platform contact exchange. Describing the selection as random addresses how the winner was chosen, not whether the claim process is trustworthy or whether the prize was delivered.

citations.quote: it randomly picks the comments from that particular video and then it chooses a winner for you
I want you to email me your contact information and so we can chat about getting you your Alta gift card

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The request is limited in the record to arranging delivery of the stated prize; it does not ask for payment, credentials, or a purchase. The wrong-side argument turns uncertainty about delivery and data handling into evidence of a scam. The source expressly frames the contact request as a way to discuss getting the gift card, while the winner and prize are clearly identified.

citations.quote: so we can chat about getting you your Alta gift card
you are the winner of the $25 Ulta gift card

opening.argument: Several pressure and channel signals appear together: a $25 gift-card promise, a 24-hour deadline, an email request for contact information, and multiple external links. The description instructs the winner to claim quickly, while separately directing viewers to an online cashback link and listing a personal email address. Even if the giveaway is genuine, this combination normalizes moving viewers from a public video into private contact and external web flows in connection with financial or retail incentives. The material does not document safeguards, verification, or delivery, so the reward claim remains an unusually easy acquisition presented with urgency and off-platform routing.

citations.quote: YOU HAVE 24 HOURS TO CLAIM YOUR PRIZE
Email Me @ [EMAIL]
Get Money Back just for shopping online:Use My link below and you will earn $10 on yourfirst purchase totaling $25 or More!
I want you to email me your contact information

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side isolates the deadline and contact request as benign delivery instructions, but it does not address their combination with external-link promotion. The description also includes a cashback inducement tied to using a link and making a qualifying purchase. That broader funnel is relevant because the viewer is not merely shown a winner; viewers are directed toward contact and an incentivized external shopping path.

citations.quote: Get Money Back just for shopping online:Use My link below and you will earn $10 on yourfirst purchase totaling $25 or More!
Email Me @ [EMAIL]

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cashback link is described separately from the giveaway, and the record does not show that using it is required to receive the gift card. Nor does a deadline or email address establish deception by itself. The material presents the contact request as prize-arrangement communication, not payment, login, or purchase verification.

citations.quote: so we can chat about getting you your Alta gift card
The winner will receive an ULTA BEAUTY gift card in the amount of $25.00

opening.argument: Although framed as a winner announcement, the video functions as audience-growth and participation promotion. It asks viewers to like and subscribe, emphasizes gratitude to subscribers, advertises another possible giveaway, and places a separate cashback referral invitation in the description. The prize announcement therefore operates within a broader mechanism for steering viewers toward continued engagement, private contact, and an external shopping link. The $25 card is the attention-grabbing incentive that makes those actions attractive. The presentation does not independently establish that the reward was actually sent, so the promotional framing should not be treated as proof of a completed legitimate transaction.

citations.quote: if you are not a subscriber and you're watching this video ... don't forget to subscribe to my channel because I'm planning another giveaway, possibly for Christmas
Don't Forget to join EBATES! Get Money Back just for shopping online:Use My link below and you will earn $10 on yourfirst purchase totaling $25 or More!
thank you so much Everybody for watching my videos and liking my videos and comment on my videos

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference opening describes the giveaway mechanics but overlooks the video's surrounding promotional function. The speaker solicits subscriptions and engagement and announces another giveaway, while the description promotes an external cashback link. Those calls to action show that the prize announcement is also a vehicle for participation and referral activity, not simply neutral reporting of a completed award.

citations.quote: don't forget to subscribe to my channel because I'm planning another giveaway, possibly for Christmas
Don't Forget to join EBATES!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Audience engagement and future giveaways are ordinary channel promotion, not evidence that the announced prize is fraudulent. The record identifies a random comment-selection process and a named recipient, and the contact request is expressly connected to arranging the gift card. Promotional context cannot substitute for proof that the reward promise is deceptive.
